featured_reviews.review_text:
We booked this property expecting a comfortable stay based on the listing, but unfortunately our experience was so disappointing that we decided not to stay and left it immediately.
The biggest issue was the lack of clarity regarding parking. We were travelling by car and found the parking situation extremely inconvenient. While the host did try to assist and temporarily accommodate us, the arrangement was not reliable and did not resolve the problem.
We were also disappointed by the location and surrounding area, which did not match the expectations we had based on the listing. The area felt very different from what we had anticipated, and had we known the actual situation beforehand, we would not have booked the property.
The listing should provide much clearer information about practical aspects such as parking, accessibility, and the nature of the surrounding neighbourhood. These details are important for guests, especially families and travellers coming from outside.
